summary: Shows tagging individual tasks with one or more tags and applying the same tag (ntp) to several tasks so --tags ntp runs only those.
questions: How do I add a tag to a task?
Can a task have multiple tags?
How do I run only the ntp tasks?

answer_card.title: Tagging individual tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Install the servers
  ansible.builtin.yum:
    name: [httpd, memcached]
    state: present
  tags:
  - packages
  - webservers

- name: Install ntp
  ansible.builtin.yum:
    name: ntp
  tags: ntp
```

`ansible-playbook site.yml --tags ntp` runs only tasks tagged `ntp`.
